items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Completion / Diagnostics

*   [saghen/blink.cmp (⭐5.5k)](https://github.com/saghen/blink.cmp) - Really fast completion with LSP & snippet support, along with signature help, cmdline completion, and autobracket support (based on semantic tokens).
    *   [saghen/blink.compat (⭐203)](https://github.com/saghen/blink.compat) - Compatibility layer for using `nvim-cmp` sources on `blink.cmp`.
    *   [Kaiser-Yang/blink-cmp-git (⭐75)](https://github.com/Kaiser-Yang/blink-cmp-git) - `blink.cmp` source for Git.
    *   [disrupted/blink-cmp-conventional-commits (⭐22)](https://github.com/disrupted/blink-cmp-conventional-commits) - `blink.cmp` source for [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
    *   [mikavilpas/blink-ripgrep.nvim (⭐94)](https://github.com/mikavilpas/blink-ripgrep.nvim) - `blink.cmp` source for `ripgrep` / `git grep`.
    *   [bydlw98/blink-cmp-env (⭐14)](https://github.com/bydlw98/blink-cmp-env) - `blink.cmp` source for environment variables.
    *   [bydlw98/blink-cmp-sshconfig (⭐4)](https://github.com/bydlw98/blink-cmp-sshconfig) - `blink.cmp` source for `sshconfig` files.
    *   [mgalliou/blink-cmp-tmux (⭐9)](https://github.com/mgalliou/blink-cmp-tmux) - `blink.cmp` source for [tmux (⭐39k)](https://github.com/tmux/tmux).
    *   [moyiz/blink-emoji.nvim (⭐65)](https://github.com/moyiz/blink-emoji.nvim) - `blink.cmp` source for GitHub Markdown emojis.
    *   [erooke/blink-cmp-latex (⭐9)](https://github.com/erooke/blink-cmp-latex) - `blink.cmp` source for LaTeX.

### Utility / Cursorline

*   [gisketch/triforce.nvim (⭐79)](https://github.com/gisketch/triforce.nvim) - Gamified stat tracker with XP, levels, achievements, and activity heatmaps for your coding sessions with lualine integration.

### Scrolling / Tree-sitter Based

*   [saghen/filler-begone.nvim (⭐18)](https://github.com/saghen/filler-begone.nvim) - Prevents scrolling past the bottom of the buffer and showing unnecessary filler lines.

### Formatting / Indent

*   [saghen/blink.indent (⭐93)](https://github.com/saghen/blink.indent) - Performant indent guides with scope on every keystroke.
items.content_html:
